title: Before a push, the guard checks the Red-run line on each test commit it sends
why: Incident, lane page-reply-uncollapse, 2026-11-07 03:30 CST, relayed by the coordinator 03:27 CST: test-file commit 1f35b617 was pushed with no `Red-run:` line. The gap showed only at `merge --lane-lint`, after the push, so the only fix was a replacement PR for #1345. Second incident, lane pr-state-is-on-the-pr, 2026-11-07 13:28 CST: commit af063548b was pushed to report-pass-needs-record with a malformed `Red-run:` line, because check_red_run ran after the push. The fix needed a new branch, since a force push is the owner's act. So the guard must also refuse a malformed line, not only a missing one. Incidents (coordinator 00:22 CST Nov 14, relayed): #2980 to #3376 (349c2db32bca) and #3366 to #3377 (732293c9b382) were re-cut because lane lint's check_red_run found a pushed commit with test lines and no Red-run trailer; its printed remedy is a new branch plus a replacement PR. Each cost a lint cycle, a new PR number and a closed PR. Sighting 02:08 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 02:07, from lane merge-flow-after-anthropic 02:08; the lane's claims are its own, the coordinator checked only the head and files by REST; unchecked by triage): degen #705 went red at feb0df75 on `ruff format --check` (2 new test files), fixed at 3818ababa606. Lane's cause: CI runs ruff 0.17.0 (requirements-dev.txt, `make lint-py`); local 0.16.9 fails the same files, so not a version gap; the format check was most likely not run before push (a builder ran it on one script only; a test-author wrote "no ruff-format hunks in new code", wrong). Degen has no lane-touched-tests job, so lane lint reads unknown there. Guard the lane names: a pre-push `make lint-py` for a lane. Constraint to read first: decision c21 (owner: standard code lint in CI only, never on each edit) and c175 (done: the local lint gate runs code-check and zizmor as CI does); a pre-push run is not an each-edit run, but the owner's c21 word governs, so no new push-time lint without reading it. Open: whether lane lint in a child repo could run the repo's own lint target when no touched-tests job exists, which would make the pre-push step unnecessary. Sighting 02:46 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 02:44, from runner 11; unchecked by triage): degen #705 hit a ruff format failure that a pre-push red run would have caught. Case 04:48 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:47, from lane macos-jobs-gated-by-scope; its read of `lint/check_red_run.py --base origin/main`, CI at checks.yml:377; unchecked by triage): #3398 is red on that check because two pushed commits add test lines with no `Red-run:` trailer: 8bd2edd4c (one empty-flag-list case) and a2581769d (a builder round-2 rename plus a push-skip fix; tests renamed). The check's remedy for pushed commits is a NEW branch and a replacement PR, which drops the PR's records and rounds. The coordinator's pick: a replacement PR. Cost: a second lane run of rounds 1-3 for a macOS gate that is top of the CI-speed order. The coordinator filed the case under lane-lint-before-push; triage puts it here, the step whose title is the pre-push Red-run check, and points lane-lint-before-push to it. Possible false alarm, UNMEASURED: whether check_red_run flags a commit that only renames test functions; the coordinator asked the lane whether a2581769d adds any new test line. If it adds none, that is a false alarm and gets its own step.
note: Before a `git push`, the guard runs lint/check_red_run.py against the base for the commits the push sends. Cost: one git log and one diff read per push. Depends on step commit-refuses-conflict-markers, which builds the push-time check of the sent commits; this step extends that same home (building-one-home-per-capability). Done check: a red test on a push of a test commit with no Red-run line. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). No owner question. Absorbs proposed step red-run-at-commit (lane notes-fix-large-3, 18:04 CST Nov 7): 58bc56a3b and 435bafefb were pushed with `Red-run: none (...)`, a revert did not clear it, and #1631/#1632 replaced #1535/#1605. A push-time check stops that form before it lands; add a test that `Red-run: none (x)` is refused and `Red-run: none: x` allowed. Incident, Nov 7 23:14 CST (lane notes-fix-page, [ended:lane:-notes-fix-page]): a comment edit to a test file was pushed with no Red-run trailer (404b68a67 on #1482). Lane lint caught it only after the push, so the fix needed replacement PR #1785. Open PR #1582 (Refuse a push that sends a test commit with no valid Red-run trailer) builds this guard. Sighting (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run, 04:50 CST Nov 8): db10b8d6b committed a test-file edit with no Red-run line, and only CI's check_red_run would have caught it. It forced #1911 to replace #1907. Step red-run-at-commit (a commit-time hook) is folded here (coordinator, 04:51 CST Nov 8); lane verdict-instruction-false-alarm ([ended:lane:-verdict-instruction-false-alarm]) does not build it. That lane's #1376 sighting also belongs here; triage asked the lane for its detail. #1376 sighting (lane verdict-instruction-false-alarm, 04:52 CST): cfbd31c9 reworded two comment lines in hooks/test_guard.py with no Red-run trailer and was pushed; lane-lint's Red-run step (lint/check_red_run.py) caught it after a test-author flagged it. Auto mode refused both force-push forms that would fix it, so the lane opened replacement PR #1913 (third case under note lane-force-push-refused). #1949 sighting (lane revive-1042, 06:50 CST Nov 8): a comment-only edit to hooks/test_guard.py was pushed with no `Red-run: none:` trailer; lane-lint caught it after the push, and auto mode refused the force push to fix it. Same shape as #1376; the lane's other idea, a commit-time ask for the trailer, is this step's commit-side check. Third sighting (lane lint-before-record-push, 08:15 CST Nov 8; proposed step red-run-trailer-at-commit, folded here): #1898 commit 1d1067f82 added test lines with no Red-run trailer, caught only at lane lint; once pushed, only a replacement PR fixed it (#2032 replaces #1898). Its proposed step red-run-at-commit was already folded here (coordinator, 04:51 CST Nov 8). Two more sightings, Nov 8: (1) lane agent-report-shas-resolve 13:10 CST, proposed step red-run-at-commit again: comment-only commit 576ec5b5c on #1864 had no Red-run trailer; auto mode denied the force push to fix it, so the work moved to replacement PR #2235 and the review records split across two PRs. (2) moved: the check_comment_narration sightings (#1898, #2032) went to lane-lint-before-push (#2077), per the coordinator 13:13 CST. Sighting (lane timing-tests, [ended:lane:-timing-tests], 14:54 CST Nov 8; folded here, since step red-run-at-commit is done and covers revert commits only): the lane pushed 7342fd308 on #2149, a comment-only edit to hooks/test_guard.py with no Red-run trailer. Lane lint failed it 12 min later, so #2149 became replacement #2285. The lane proposes the check at `git commit` too: refuse a commit that adds lines to a test path (is_test_rel) with no Red-run trailer, naming the trailer form. Sighting (lane push-head-upstream-name, [ended:lane:-push-head-upstream-name], 17:00 CST Nov 8 by its clock; it asked for step red-run-at-commit, folded here): lint/check_red_run.py runs only at lane lint, so two comment-only commits to a test file were pushed with no Red-run trailer. That forced replacement PR #2327 for #2228. It proposed a commit-time check; a pre-push check stops the same push. Second sighting (lane fix-check-render-first, [ended:Lane-fix-check-render-first], 00:14 CST Nov 9): a one-line docstring edit in hooks/test_guard.py was committed (515e1b709) and pushed with no Red-run trailer; lint/check_red_run.py caught it only at `merge --lane-lint`, which forced replacement PR #2396 for #2392 and a fresh round 3. Both have been with batch runner 8 since 16:17 CST Nov 8, with every record done; no new case is needed. The step is done when #1582 and #2239 merge. Repeat incidents (coordinator, 05:19 CST Nov 9): lane lint's red-run check failed on an old commit with no Red-run trailer twice on Nov 8-9: #2139/#2140 at d8d10c1, and #1860/#2036 at 49a1eda1a (a comment-only change in a test file). The coordinator proposes a refusal at commit time for any commit that touches a test file with no Red-run trailer (step red-run-at-commit was folded into #1582 here), and asks whether a comment-only test change deserves an exemption.
